title: An Analysis of Large Language Models for Simulating User Responses in Surveys
findings: All tested LLMs struggled to accurately simulate human responses to survey questions related to religion, with performance only slightly above random accuracy. The proposed CLAIMSIM method increased response diversity and alignment with true distributions but did not consistently improve accuracy. A key limitation identified is that LLMs tend to produce unified, single-perspective viewpoints regardless of the specified religious demographic, limiting their ability to simulate users whose views may diverge from mainstream or model-internal norms.
